I found 39 properties missing from the directory. Nothing was written to any database or file.

How each was verified:
- Wyndham, Sonesta, My Place and WoodSpring property pages were fetched directly and read on 2026-10-11.
- hilton.com, ihg.com and redroof.com returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches. choicehotels.com and motel6.com timed out. For those brands, every field comes from the brand's own pages as surfaced through domain-restricted web search (allowed_domains = brand site). Hilton's Ankeny and Des Moines city listing pages were read directly.
- Room counts are mostly null because brand pages rarely state them.

Brands and sources checked:
- Hilton: Ankeny and Des Moines city pages.
- Marriott: Ankeny, downtown, airport, Merle Hay.
- IHG: Ankeny, downtown, airport.
- Hyatt: none in scope beyond the two already listed.
- Choice, including Radisson Americas and WoodSpring: Des Moines, Ankeny, Pleasant Hill.
- Wyndham: Days Inn, Super 8, Baymont, AmericInn, Ramada, La Quinta.
- Best Western: only Clive and the already-listed Ankeny and Altoona properties.
- Sonesta, Red Roof, and G6 (Motel 6/Studio 6).
- Extended Stay America: only West Des Moines and Urbandale, both out of scope.
- My Place.
- Independents: Butler House on Grand, Kasa Downtown, East Village and Court District searches.

Confirm before adding:
- Ramada Des Moines Airport: the production Wyndham page rendered an empty template. Its details come from the fqa. mirror.
- Two phone numbers conflict between Choice pages: Quality Inn Merle Hay and Quality Inn Ankeny.
- Super 8 Des Moines and Baymont Des Moines North were in a February 2026 auction listing; I found no outcome.
- The IHG downtown pages were flagged as old snapshots.

Left out on purpose:
- Holiday Inn Express at Drake (1140 24th St): closed in 2021 and converted to Drake student housing.
- Element by Westin East Village: only the 2021 plan was found, with no evidence it opened.
- Days Inn Merle Hay (4845 Merle Hay Rd), GrandStay Ankeny, AmericInn Ankeny and Motel 6 Des Moines South Airport (4817 Fleur Dr): none confirmed on a brand page.
- Comfort Inn Altoona (2023 Adventureland Dr): found only on third-party listings, not on choicehotels.com.
- Butler House on Grand (4507 Grand Ave): now rented as Airbnb suites. I couldn't confirm a lodging licence or an official site.
- Kasa Downtown Des Moines (550 Watson Powell Jr Way): third-party listings only, no live official page.
- Settle Inn Altoona and a 'Best Inn' on SW Army Post Rd: third-party traces only.
- Out of area: Urbandale, Johnston, Clive and West Des Moines properties, including Hilton Garden Inn and Hampton Urbandale, Revel Hotel, Hampton West Des Moines Lake Dr, Sonesta Simply Suites, Extended Stay America, Days Inn West Des Moines, Motel 6 West Des Moines and Rewind Hotel. Also Tru Norwalk and Fairfield Norwalk.

Not checked:
- State or county lodging-licence records for B&Bs.
- The Catch Des Moines lodging directory.
- Short-term-rental-only operators.

I found 44 operating properties that aren't in the directory: 25 in the Des Moines suburbs and 19 in Ames. Nothing was written to any database or file except scratch fetches in the session scratchpad.

How I found them: I pulled the full Accommodations category (274 records) from the Catch Des Moines CVB listings API, and I read the Discover Ames hotel and B&B pages. I then checked each candidate on a brand site:
- **Wyndham:** location pages for AmericInn, Days Inn, Super 8, Baymont, Microtel, La Quinta and Ramada, plus property JSON-LD.
- **Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Best Western, Red Roof:** property pages read in a browser. I also used Hilton's Iowa and West Des Moines location lists and IHG's West Des Moines list.
- **Choice:** the Ames and West Des Moines searches showed live rates for 2026-10-11. These searches also cover Radisson's Country Inn and Park Inn.
- **Sonesta and WoodSpring:** property pages. The independents (Wildwood Lodge, Revel, Rewind, Gateway) I checked on their own sites.

What I could not check:
- **Extended Stay America** and **Motel 6** redirected away from their property pages. Those entries rest on the CVB's Active status plus brand-site search snippets.
- **Hyatt** blocked me. I did not search Hyatt for other properties in these cities.
- **Radisson's own site** blocked me. I covered its brands through Choice instead.
- **Urbandale Extended Stay** (5900 Sutton Place) has only the CVB listing as a source.
- **Windsor Heights:** the CVB lists no lodging there, and none of the brand searches turned any up.
- **Room counts** are filled only where the brand page stated them.

What I deliberately left out:
- **Comfort Inn & Suites Ames near ISU Campus** (603 S 16th St, live on Choice). It matches the directory's "Comfort Inn & Suites Ames" by name, but the directory's address (1602 S Dayton Ave) looks wrong and should be checked.
- **Hotel Renovo**, Holiday Inn Express Jordan Creek and the other Hiltons, because they are already listed.
- **Econo Lodge Ames**, which Discover Ames lists but the Choice Ames search did not return.
- **Baymont Ames**, now Park Inn, and **Candlewood West Des Moines**, now Sonesta Simply Suites.
- **GrandStay Johnston**, now La Quinta Johnston, and the earlier **Sleep Inn Urbandale**, now Revel.
- **Hotel Memorial Union**: I found no current hotel operation.
- **Home2 Suites Waukee**: planned, but not on Hilton's site.
- **B&Bs**: Sunny Heights B&B (17641 Templeton Rd, Ames) and Loya's Little House B&B appear only on undated Discover Ames pages. I could not find a lodging licence or a dated source for either. Homestead Inn is an Airbnb.

Data conflicts to resolve in the directory:
- **Directory errors:** the directory's Hampton Inn & Suites Waukee address does not appear on Hilton's Waukee list. Its Holiday Inn Express Jordan Creek is at 240 Jordan Creek Pkwy per the CVB, not S Jordan Creek.
- **Ramada Tropics city:** Wyndham's own page puts the hotel in Des Moines 50322, while the CVB files it under Urbandale.
- **Red Lion Grimes address:** Sonesta gives 251 Gateway Cir, while the CVB gives 251 SE Gateway Dr.
- **Gateway zip:** the hotel's site gives 50014, while Discover Ames gives 50010.
- **Phones:** Choice entries in Ames take their phone numbers from Discover Ames, and the Waukee Sleep Inn and MainStay showed no phone on the page I read, so those are null.
